notes.title: SILT patch is now released
notes.notes:
We’d like to say a massive thank you to everyone who has dived into the depths of SILT, and an extra thanks to everyone who has left us a review. Your feedback is really helpful to us, and we’ve been able to make a number of improvements to the game because of it, including…

[h2]New gameplay enhancements[/h2]

A new patch has been released this week which solves issues with the possession mechanic, includes a screen-mode option to graphics settings menu, and much more. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1325890/view/3323108056635703011][b]Click here to view the full patch notes[/b][/url]. 

[h2]Steam reviews are REALLY helpful[/h2]

If you get the chance, a review would be awesome. We have been taking all your comments on board, and it’s been great to hear about your experiences with SILT. This is our debut game so feedback is really useful, so do let us know how you got on in the abyss. Thanks!

To keep up to date with the latest SILT updates, you can follow us on Twitter [b][url=https://twitter.com/SiltGame]@SiltGame[/url][/b], TikTok [b][url=https://www.tiktok.com/@silt_game]@Silt_Game[/url][/b], or Instagram [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/spiralcircusgames/]@spiralcircusgames[/url][/b].

notes.title: SILT - Patch Notes - 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, just a quick update on the new patch we've released today. The patch includes:

[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]

[list]
[*] Added screen-mode option to graphics settings menu. Allows full-screen exclusive or full-screen windowed modes.
[/list]

[b]BUG FIX[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the diver taking damage at the same moment they exit a level could cause the game to hang. 
[*] Fixed a bug that caused unexpected behaviour when the diver died while holding the possession button.
[/list]

[b]SPOILER FIXES[/b]

[b]Gameplay & Balancing Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed one of the [spoiler]three bobbit worms in Chapter 4, Scene 2 (Bobbit Tunnels 1)[/spoiler]. This makes the puzzle solution more straightforward to execute once the player has figured it out, giving the player more room to [spoiler]safely manoeuvre creatures through that area[/spoiler].
[*] Removed and repositioned some of [spoiler]the jellyfish mines in Chapter 4, Scene 4 (Chasm)[/spoiler]. This makes the traversal of this room slightly more forgiving and less frustrating.
[*] Prevented a soft-lock that could occur in Chapter 4, Scene 7 [spoiler](Nursery 2)[/spoiler] where the player could [spoiler]be trapped in the bottom area of the plant nursery when the light tentacle is damaged[/spoiler].
[/list]
[b]
Quality-of-life [/b]
[list]
[*] Tweaked possession behaviour so that it never targets the creature the player is currently in control of. This helps in situations where the player is trying to possess in a tight space, such as [spoiler]the elevator switches in chapter 3[/spoiler], and should reduce frustrating “mis-possessions”.
[/list]

Thanks for your feedback!
